meta.print_convention: Row stamped D 00:00 UTC = the close of the Binance USD-M daily candle that ENDED at D 00:00 (opened D-1 00:00): the decision print. aux['exec_prices'] = close of the 1h candle opened at D 00:00 (the 01:00 UTC price, one hour after the decision); aux['exec_prices_alt'] = close of the 1h candle opened at D 01:00 (the 02:00 UTC price). A candle with zero trades is not a print (NaN); nothing is forward-filled - with ONE exception: on the last live row of an instrument that stopped trading, both execution series carry its final traded price (the settlement print, see settlement_prints). carry on row D = minus the sum of the funding rates stamped in (D-1 01:00, D 01:00], i.e. aligned to the execution interval.
meta.exec_print_clock: row timestamp + 1 hour (01:00 UTC); alt: row timestamp + 2 hours (02:00 UTC)
meta.universe_rule: aux['universe_mask'][t,i] = (i has >= 60 traded daily candles ended strictly before t) AND (i's mean quote volume over the 30 consecutive candles ending at t ranks in the top 30 of all crypto perps with a complete window) AND (i traded in the hour that ended at t). Ranked among crypto-coin USDT perpetuals only (see manifest exclusions). An instrument is one uninterrupted trading segment of a symbol (a break of >= 3 days starts a new one).
meta.carry_convention: - sum(funding rate) over funding stamps in (01:00 of D-1, 01:00 of D]; 0.0 where there is no funding record (see aux['funding_obs'] = number of funding events in the interval; funding was downloaded only for EVER_IN_MASK symbols — all other columns carry 0.0)
meta.tbill_convention: effective fed funds (FRED DFF) of the last calendar day before the row, / 360
meta.settlement_prints: When an instrument stops trading (delisting, suspension >= 3 days) its real execution prints end one row before its last live row z (z holds the close of its last traded daily candle = its final traded price; the 01:00 candle of z never trades). The final traded price is BOOKED on row z: exec_prices[z] = exec_prices_alt[z] = prices[z] = exec_prices[z-1] * (1 + terminal_return[z]). aux['settlement_row'] flags those cells; aux['universe_mask'] is False on them and every field is NaN afterwards. Effect in the engine (held = w.shift(1), r = F/F.shift(1) - 1): a target still held on row z-1 earns the terminal move on row z; a target of zero decided on row z-1 was executed at that row's real 01:00 print and does not. These are the ONLY cells of exec_prices that are not a print later than the row's decision print (trading had stopped before the row timestamp); they can only close a position. In the conductor's notation t_last = z-1 (the last row with a real execution print) and the settlement print sits on t_last + 1.
meta.terminal_return_note: aux['terminal_return'][z, i] = prices[z, i] / (last REAL execution print of i) - 1 on the settlement row z of an instrument that stopped trading, 0 elsewhere - kept for audit; it equals exec_prices[z] / exec_prices[z-1] - 1. A realised return, never a signal input.

rest.klines: https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/klines (interval=1d for every symbol the exchange knows; interval=1h only for months the archive does not hold)

archive.used_for: 1d klines of names the exchange no longer knows; 1h klines and fundingRate (monthly zips)

sources.choice: Daily candles: REST for every symbol REST still serves — all symbols in exchangeInfo (TRADING and SETTLING, full history incl. 2019-09-08..2019-12-31 which the archive lacks) and the delisted names it still answers for (e.g. LUNAUSDT); the archive (monthly zips + daily zips for the days the monthly zips miss) only for the re-used '...SETTLED' names REST does not serve. per_symbol.daily_source says which. Hourly candles and funding: archive monthly zips (sha256-checked against the published .CHECKSUM); REST for months without a monthly zip (before 2020-01 and the current month) and for the holes inside monthly zips (e.g. 26-28 Feb 2022); daily archive zips where REST has nothing.

download_jobs.how_to_check_completion: every detached stage writes raw/binance/futures_um/_stage_<stage>_DONE.json when it finishes and ends its log (raw/binance/logs/<market>-<stage>.log) with '... DONE'; a stage that is still running has neither

reconstructed.why: an --only-new pass (0 symbols, 15:18:04Z) overwrote this marker before the stage wrote a separate marker for such passes; the values are those of the last FULL pass
reconstructed.evidence: raw/binance/logs/perp-hourly.log lines '2026-11-10T14:57:17Z [perp-hourly] start symbols=318 ...' and '2026-11-10T15:04:13Z [perp-hourly] DONE'; a third full pass started 15:15:32Z was stopped by the operator after 36 symbols (it only refreshed the current month)

archive_start_note: USD-M monthly archive kline files start 2020-01; BTCUSDT trades since 2019-09-08 and those candles come from REST. Each symbol's true first candle is in per_symbol.first_candle_open.

exclusions.note: TRADIFI_PERPETUAL contracts (equity, commodity, FX, pre-IPO underlyings) are a separate Binance contract type and are NOT crypto; the brief listed only stablecoin/fiat/index exclusions, so this exclusion is the data layer's call and is reported.

phantom_candles.rule: a daily candle with zero trades is not a print

segments.rule: a symbol that does not trade for >= 3 consecutive days is split: the last segment keeps the symbol name, earlier ones are <SYMBOL>@<YYYYMMDD of their last row>; no history is shared across the break

decision_print_crosscheck.what: daily close on row D vs close of the 1h candle opened D-1 23:00 (independent files)

settlement_prints.rule: exec_prices[z] = exec_prices_alt[z] = prices[z] (the final traded price) on the last live row z of every instrument that stopped trading before the panel's final row; universe_mask False on z; NaN afterwards; see meta.settlement_prints

funding.missing_funding_rule: carry = 0.0 where no funding record falls in the interval

price_gaps.rule: no forward fill in this lane; gaps of 1-2 days stay NaN inside an instrument, longer ones split it (see segments)
